# Fallout Day: All Offers, Twitch Drops & Free To Play Week

![Fallout Day: All Offers, Twitch Drops & Free To Play Week](/uploads/418_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Fallout Day: The day the bombs fell

October 23, 2077 was the day the bombs fell and the Great War (Sino-American War between America and China) broke out. This thermonuclear world war led to the collapse of the world at that time in just 2 hours. America and the rest of the world was turned into a "wasteland" that day. The effects of this war are still felt 200 years later.

See Wiki: Great War

## Free Play Event

From October 22nd - October 29th, 2023, Fallout 76 will be playable for free on all platforms.

![Free to Play 2024](/uploads/fo76-freetoplay-2024.jpeg) 

Source: Fallout on x.com

## Atom packages offers

The Atom Bundle packages are also on offer with **20 - 35% discount** until October 29, 2024

- **500 atoms** : €3.99 (-20%)
- **1100 atoms** : €7.49 (-25%)
- **2400 atoms** : €13.99 (-30%)
- **5000 atoms** : €25.99 (-35%)

Xbox Deals | Playstation offers | PC Steam offers

## Skyline Valley Bundle "Lost Treasures Package" Offers

Until October 30th or November 3rd, 2024, the new bundle will be available on Xbox, Playstation and PC for €17.99.

The bundle or package contains the following items:

- V63 Power Armor Paint
- V63 Power Armor Jetpack
- V63 chassis stand frame
- Vault 63 door display
- Paul the Mole plush toy
- Weather control station Skyline Valley
- Photo pose: lightning rod

See: Skyline Valley Bundle 'Lost Treasures Package': Contents & Offers

## Continue Fallout games on offer until October 29th, 2024

- **Fallout 4: Game of the Year Edition** for 9.99 (-75%)
- **Fallout 4: DLCs** (-40 to 50%)
- **Fallout 3** for €2.49 (-75%)

## Fallout Day: Twitch Drops

There will be a Fallout Day Twitch stream on October 23rd, 2024 at 9 p.m. Free items await you there: **Twitch Drops**

Here you can see the expected Twitch Drops

There will be a community parade in the stream itself, which may also feature Nuka Knights.

![Fallout Day Twitch Stream & Twitch Drops](/uploads/fod-announcement-social-16x9-03.png) 

Source: bethesda.net
